newsitem.title: UK: Hill Samuel sponsors cricket club for 750,000 stg.
newsitem.headline: Hill Samuel sponsors cricket club for 750,000 stg.

text.p: Hill Samuel Asset Management said on Thursday it would sponsor the Middlesex County Cricket Club for more than 750,000 stg over the next three years.
The sponsorship will be followed by the firm's new 2.5 million stg "rebranding" advertising campaign in 1997, Hill Samuel said in a statement.

Alan Moore, Deputy Chief Executive of Lloyds TSB, which owns Hill Samuel, said the group was determined "to grow an asset management business as part of the core activities of the group," and brand awareness was a key part of that.
It plans to launch a pension unit trust in 1997, a savings plan for an emerging companies trust, a free share exchange scheme and a new range of personal equity plans, the statement said.
Hill Samuel is Britain's seventh largest pension fund manager, controlling some 11.3 billion stg, it said. The company manages more than 30.5 billion stg for British investors.
